description:
scripts/dev_loop_dashboard.py sets TARGET_MAKE_TARGETS = 90 and renders '<= 90', so the first live report (run 44646358143) shows 190 public Make targets as a miss. The owner decision recorded in dlv2-82 (2026-11-07) replaced the <= 90 threshold with a capability-preserving ceiling of 190, and the same-method baseline is 211 (dlv2-30day-metrics description).

Guardrails: read the threshold from the recorded decision rather than a second hard-coded number if a machine-readable source exists; do not change the counting method (scripts/check_make_targets.py).
